title: Identifying an unknown carbonyl compound
body: An organic compound A has the molecular formula C8H8O. A student records these observations. (1) A gives an orange-red precipitate with 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine (2,4-DNP) reagent. (2) A does not reduce Tollens' reagent or Fehling's solution. (3) On heating with iodine in the presence of sodium hydroxide, A gives a yellow precipitate. (4) A does not decolourise bromine water or Baeyer's reagent, although its formula shows a high degree of unsaturation. (5) On drastic oxidation with chromic acid, A gives a carboxylic acid B with the molecular formula C7H6O2.
